description: LLM integration for summarization and keywords, vector database (ChromaDB) for RAG embeddings and search, and the RAG chat endpoint. This adds the AI-powered features: auto-summarization on document processing, vector indexing, and a chat interface that retrieves relevant document chunks to answer questions.
steps: Add dependencies to pyproject.toml: openai, chromadb, tiktoken, langchain-text-splitters (for recursive character text splitting).

Create app/core/llm.py: OpenAI client wrapper that initializes from settings. Provide functions: generate_summary(text) -> str, extract_keywords(text) -> list[str], generate_embeddings(texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]], chat_completion(messages, context) -> str. Use gpt-4o-mini for summarization/keywords, text-embedding-3-small for embeddings. Include graceful fallback if OPENAI_API_KEY is not set (return placeholder summary, empty keywords).

Create app/services/vectordb.py (VectorDBService): initialize ChromaDB persistent client (storage in ./chroma_db/), create collection per group or single collection with group metadata. Methods: index_document(doc_id, group_id, chunks: list[str], embeddings), search(query_embedding, group_id=None, top_k=5) -> list of (chunk_text, doc_id, score), delete_document(doc_id). Use chunk metadata to store doc_id, group_id, chunk_index.

Create app/services/chunker.py: split markdown content into chunks using langchain-text-splitters RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter with chunk_size from settings (default 1000) and overlap 200. Return list of chunks with metadata (position, heading context).

Integrate LLM summarization into pipeline: after conversion in app/services/pipeline.py, call generate_summary and extract_keywords on the markdown content, store results in Document model fields (summary, keywords). Then chunk the content, generate embeddings, and index in vector DB.

Create app/api/search.py: POST /api/search (query: str, group_id: optional int) -> list of search results with document info and relevance score. POST /api/chat (query: str, group_id: optional int, history: optional list) -> RAG response with citations. The chat endpoint retrieves top-k chunks, constructs a prompt with context, and calls chat_completion.
Create app/schemas/search.py: SearchRequest, SearchResult, ChatRequest, ChatResponse Pydantic models. ChatResponse includes answer text and list of source citations (doc_id, doc_name, chunk_text).

Create tests/test_search.py: test chunking logic, test vector DB indexing and search with mocked embeddings, test search endpoint, test chat endpoint with mocked LLM responses. Use monkeypatch/mock to avoid actual OpenAI API calls in tests.
Create tests/test_llm.py: test that LLM functions handle missing API key gracefully, test summary generation with mocked OpenAI response, test embedding generation with mocked response.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'uv run pytest tests/ -v' passes all tests including new search and LLM tests
POST /api/search with a query returns relevant document chunks (tested with pre-indexed data)
POST /api/chat returns a generated answer with source citations
Document processing pipeline now generates summary and keywords (visible in Document response)
ChromaDB collection is created and documents are indexed after processing
All LLM functions gracefully handle missing OPENAI_API_KEY without crashing
Text chunking produces overlapping chunks of configured size
verification: uv run ruff check app/ tests/
